from_quote: the fatal power of regulating the times and places of election
rationale: Names "the power of regulating the times and places of election" as one objector's complaint, echoing this clause's words "Times, Places" of holding elections.
to_quote: The Times, Places and Manner of holding Elections

from_quote: the junction of the Senate with the President in the responsible function of appointing to offices
rationale: Names the joint part of the Senate and the President "in the responsible function of appointing to offices," the appointment provision of this clause.

from_quote: the trial of impeachments by the Senate
rationale: Names "the trial of impeachments by the Senate," echoing this clause's words giving the Senate the power "to try all Impeachments."
to_quote: The Senate shall have the sole Power to try all Impeachments

from_quote: it empowers the Senate, with the concurrence of the Executive, to make treaties
rationale: Names the power of the Senate, "with the concurrence of the Executive, to make treaties," the treaty provision of this clause.

from_quote: treaties which are to be the laws of the land
rationale: Says treaties under the new Constitution "are to be the laws of the land," echoing this clause's words "the supreme Law of the Land."
to_quote: the supreme Law of the Land

from_quote: Is the importation of slaves permitted by the new Constitution for twenty years?
rationale: Names the new Constitution's permission of "the importation of slaves" for "twenty years," the provision of this clause.
